messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate from serving-cluster-usw2. Metric spike detected: pod restarts + CUDA errors. Auto-pager: @oncall-ryan

oncall-ryan: seeing ~30% error rate on /v1/generate. GPU pods in ns=redwood-serving are restarting with OOMs. paging eng-sre-maya and eng-runtime-zhang now.

eng-sre-maya: acknowledged. grabbing logs. can you paste a sample of the CUDA error?

eng-runtime-zhang: pasting from one of the pod logs:

```
I tensorflow/core/common_runtime/gpu/gpu_device.cc:1234] Failed to allocate GPU memory
E CudaDriver: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 2048MB, gpu=0
W serving/runtime: kv-cache timeout while streaming, retrying rpc to peer 10.2.8.45
E runtime: kernel launch failed: unknown error (cudaErrorUnknown)
```

eng-sre-maya: interesting — we also see repeated RDMA timeouts in node dmesg: `mlx5_core: HCA port 1 error: event: remote peer timeout` and lots of retransmit counters.

infra-nina: on the infra side I'm seeing port counters incrementing on the IB switch for the usc-west2 pod rack. Packet retransmits + link flaps around 10:04 UTC. Opening ticket with cloud provider; may be fabric-level.

support-ellie: customers posting 500s in support queue. Top impact: 3 mid-market tenants in US-WEST2, some long-running streaming prompts dropped. ETA on mitigation?

eng-runtime-zhang: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Enable TCP fallback for cross-node gRPC to avoid RDMA for serving routes; 2) reduce batch size and concurrency on affected deployments to lower memory pressure; 3) restart RDMA driver on nodes after provider check; 4) route traffic to healthy region if capacity allows. Doing 1 & 2 now.

oncall-ryan: do the commands and post them here so I can escalate if needed.

eng-runtime-zhang: applying config change to turn off GPUDirect/RDMA for the serving plugin: `kubectl -n redwood-serving set env ds/serve-nvidia RDMA_ENABLED=false` then `kubectl -n redwood-serving rollout restart daemonset/serve-nvidia`

eng-sre-maya: scaled down deployment `model-v2` from replicas=12 -> 6 and `kubectl -n redwood-serving patch deployment model-v2 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","env":[{"name":"MAX_BATCH_SIZE","value":"4"},{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"2"}]}]}}}}'`

incident-bot: NOTE: outage_start=1777777765, severity=sev2, impacted_region=us-west-2, affected_resource=serving-cluster-usw2

infra-nina: cloud provider responded: we see noisy link on fabric switch 3 affecting ports 24-28; hardware-level retries. They will patch/replace the leaf. Replacement ETA ~ 40 minutes.

eng-runtime-zhang: after disabling RDMA, we are seeing reduced immediate OOMs. GPU pods still sometimes report `kernel launch failed` but restart rate dropped from 12/hr -> 1/hr. Looks promising.

support-ellie: relaying to customers: we applied a temporary routing and configuration change to reduce errors. Some requests may be slower; engineers are on it. pinging the three highest-traffic customers now.

oncall-ryan: handing off to @oncall-ava for overnight monitoring once we stabilize. ava, pls ack when you can take over.

oncall-ava: ack. I'll be on watch and will coordinate next steps if infra replacement doesn't fully resolve.

eng-sre-maya: additional mitigation: set per-node kube-proxy to favor TCP fallback for intra-node path: `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_retries2=5` and apply a temporary iptables rule to prefer TCP on the serving namespace. pushing now.

product-lars: any customer SLA hits? need to prepare comms.

support-ellie: initial tally: ~2% of total requests in US-WEST2 returned 5xx during the 10:02-10:25 window. Three paying customers reported degraded UX; no data loss. Will prepare incident banner draft after final impact numbers.

eng-runtime-zhang: to prevent cascading OOMs we also added a per-pod restartBackoff increase so hot loops don't immediately respawn: `spec.template.spec.terminationGracePeriodSeconds=30` and `spec.progressDeadlineSeconds=600` on the runtime deployments.

incident-bot: UPDATE: mitigation applied. severity -> sev3. continuing monitoring.

infra-nina: cloud provider replaced the faulty leaf fabric module at 10:39 UTC. counters normalized. No more retransmits on ports 24-28.

eng-sre-maya: observing stable pod behavior for 20 minutes. error rate back to baseline ~0.5% in region. rolling back TCP fallback to re-enable RDMA for perf test on a canary slice: `kubectl -n redwood-serving set env ds/serve-nvidia RDMA_ENABLED=true --record` then watch.

eng-runtime-zhang: canary passed at 11:05 UTC. re-enabled RDMA for 10% of traffic; will gradually increase. memory errors did not reappear on canary nodes.

oncall-ryan: handing final ownership to @eng-sre-maya for post-incident thread/postmortem. maya, pls own RCA and follow-ups.

eng-sre-maya: taking ownership. Preliminary suspected root cause: intermittent IB fabric packet loss caused RPC retries and increased memory pressure in runtime (retries + backpressure increased KV cache usage and unrolled request state -> OOM + kernel timeouts). Follow-ups:
- formal RCA and timeline
- validate RDMA error handling in runtime, add circuit-breaker to avoid unbounded memory growth on retries
- improve alerting to correlate IB counters + GPU OOMs
- run chaos test for IB packet loss to validate fallback flows
- customer comms draft (support + product)

product-lars: thanks. please include the customer impact numbers and slack timeline for comms pkg.

support-ellie: drafting an incident banner and post to status page after RCA.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: mitigated=1777777890, severity=sev3 -> monitor for regressions.

eng-sre-maya: postmortem owner assigned. I'll share a draft within 24h. big thanks to everyone who jumped in. :heart:

support-ellie: note: ticket numbers for affected customers attached to postmortem doc later.

oncall-ava: I'll keep watch and escalate if error rate creeps up.

eng-runtime-zhang: adding follow-up tech tasks to backlog: RB-2102 (RDMA circuit breaker), RB-2103 (KV cache throttling under retry storms), RB-2104 (improved RDMA instrumentation).

product-lars: good job all.
